sources.title: Les pin's de Septembre a Disneyland Paris
Les medailles du Disneyland Paris Magic Run Weekend 2018 devoilees

claims.value: Disneyland Paris Villains open edition pins (September 2018)
claims.note: villain-themed OE pins released to refresh the pin trading offer
article calls the release Open Edition pins
Sept 2018 preview: a series tied to the most iconic villains out early in the month

claims.value: villain open-edition pins plus a Villains lanyard; characters listed (Cruella, Ursula, Jafar, Evil Queen, Captain Hook, Queen of Hearts, Maleficent) but per-pin split not described
medal pins reproduce the 2018 villain-themed medals; the two challenge medals (31 km / 36 km) are in Maleficent colours
claims.note: official medal article; describes medals, not pins directly - pin designs still unnamed
